# redteam-suite

> Run a versioned battery of benign prompt injection, system prompt leak and jailbreak probes against a target you own and report findings Python package `trysac-redteam-suite`, import name `redteam_suite`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
